title: sida elegans
intro: Sida elegans, commonly known as the "False Mallow", is a plant species that belongs to the Malvaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Sida elegans include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which can help in reducing fever, alleviating inflammation, and relieving congestion. The bioactive constituents of Sida elegans include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory effects.
